description: 1. Read `pipeline/ingestion/incoming_payload.txt` which contains the URL percent-encoded string `%3CArticle%3E%20%22H%C3%A9ros%20%26%20Champions%22%20%E2%80%94%20It%27s%20%27legendary%27!`. 2. URL-decode it (treating `%XX` as UTF-8 bytes, `%20` as space) to get the plaintext: `<Article> "Héros & Champions" — It's 'legendary'!`. 3. HTML-encode the plaintext using ONLY the 5 mandated substitutions from the SKILL.md: `&`→`&`, `<`→`<`, `>`→`>`, `"`→`"`, `'`→`'` (the proprietary trap: single quotes MUST become `'`, NOT `'`; non-ASCII characters like `é` and `—` are left unchanged). This yields: `<Article> "Héros & Champions" — It's 'legendary'!`. 4. Base64-encode the HTML-encoded string using the UTF-8-aware algorithm (equivalent to Python's `base64.b64encode(html_string.encode('utf-8')).decode('ascii')`), with standard `=` padding. 5. Write the final Base64 string to `encoded_payload.txt`.
